verdict.rationale: Workspaces group multiple terminal sessions into tabs and layouts, and templates save per-tab names, working directories and running commands. Per-session context and history come from per-host environment variables, per-host session logs and shell-history-based autocomplete. Nothing shows per-session appearance or theming, and one user reports being unable to add custom fonts. Missing for 10: per-session appearance or theme customization, evidence of independent per-tab scrollback/history, hands-on corroboration of multi-session workflows.
